rules.rule: No standing tagline. Campaign line 'Totally Edikted' is BF 2026 only; never invent a tagline.

Never use any word on the compliance banned list (19 words) in customer-facing copy: eco-friendly, chemical-free, toxin-free, non-toxic, detox, hypoallergenic, antibacterial, cures, heals, eczema, dermatologist-approved, clinically proven, plastic-free, zero waste, carbon negative, climate positive, guaranteed, miracle, sweatshop-free.

Use the brand vocabulary: at least one brand word per asset (offer-only lines exempt). Brand words: shop, fits, fit, need, obsessed, babe, babes, cozy, hot, dream, outfit, haul, must-have, must-haves, edikted, rotation, vibe, vibes, era, energy, cute, new drop, drop, sale, black friday, irl, rn, girl, gno, tune in, going out, set, sets. Product pages use the product vocabulary: model wears, item care, polyester, spandex, cotton, nylon, rayon, detailing, closure, fabric, measurements, neckline, polyamide.
Write the brand name as 'Edikted' in running copy. Never: Edicted, EDICTED, Edikted Clothing.
Product names keep Edikted's pattern: a first name + descriptors + garment (e.g. 'Cecilya Bandage Mini Dress'). Never drop the first name.
Serial comma: Edikted uses both styles; no rule beyond clarity (observed 0 assets with, 2 without).
Prices as the catalog shows them ($26 or $25.99); never invent cents.
Percentages as numerals: '60% OFF', not 'sixty percent'.
Ellipses and line breaks are allowed for teasers ('tune in TOMORROW…'); no double hyphens.
Emoji in product pages and web copy: none; email body: 1–8.
Emoji per organic social caption: 1–5. At least one.
Emoji per paid ad: 1–6. All-caps words (excluding acronyms) per ad: 1–14; per social caption: up to 14; per PDP: none.
Exclamation marks: ads up to 3, social up to 2, PDP up to 0, web up to 2, email body up to 3.
Reading level: grade 9 or below (Flesch-Kincaid) for ads, email, web and PDP copy of 3+ sentences.
Sentences average 22 words or fewer (ads, email, web); a spaced em dash or an emoji counts as a break.
Speak to her as 'you' or 'babe'; the brand is 'we'/'us' ('Thank Us Later').
Sale copy always pairs the savings with '*Based on comp value' and, for US-only offers, '*US only'.
Tone — promo: hype, caps on the number and the event, 1–5 emoji; never threatening ('you'll regret it').
